properties/record_id: Numeric inspection-record reference from history. Omit to list available records in this session.
properties/field: Record string to page: output (default), error, or command. Ignored when listing records.
properties/offset: Starting decoded-character offset for a record, or record offset for listing. Start at 0; follow next_offset.
properties/limit: Maximum characters per record page (default 4000, maximum 12000), or records per listing page (default 20, maximum 100).
